class Solution:
    def insertIntoBST(self, root: TreeNode | None, val: int) -> TreeNode | None:
        vals = []
        def inorder(node):
            if not node: return
            inorder(node.left)
            vals.append(node.val)
            inorder(node.right)
        inorder(root)
        import bisect
        bisect.insort(vals, val)
        def build(l, r):
            if l > r: return None
            m = (l + r) // 2
            node = TreeNode(vals[m])
            node.left = build(l, m - 1)
            node.right = build(m + 1, r)
            return node
        return build(0, len(vals) - 1)

class Solution:
    def recoverTree(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> None:
        nodes = []
        vals = []
        def inorder(node):
            if not node: return
            inorder(node.left)
            nodes.append(node)
            vals.append(node.val)
            inorder(node.right)
        inorder(root)
        vals.sort()
        for node, val in zip(nodes, vals):
            node.val = val
